scope: Synthetic bridge browser adapter and visual review only; not installed-native or physical-controller acceptance.
reviewMethod: All six original PNGs opened using view_image individually or in pairs, matched to frozen report states and hashes.

captures.note: Original title and all primary actions visible; focus outline and full supplied ID readable. The 28vh side panel scroll area clips secondary service/address/port details at 960x540; it does not clip the ID.
Actual manual UP acceleration after unchanged countdown; original cars, track, race HUD and minimap rendered; actual supplied ID visible, no modal.
Original pause menu and focus clear; side card stays visible; snapshot paused and zero controls.
Lifecycle freeze overlay visible above original race; deliberate START/A resume instruction and supplied ID readable.
Original race visible without pause modal; state playing after START was held across at least three consumed frames.
Original race visible and active after deliberate reconnect resume; no pause modal, actual test ID visible.

limitations: Short start-of-race manual-driving observation only; no full lap, complete race, career completion or performance claim.
960 title panel secondary connection details require its scroll area; complete controller ID remains visible.
Browser uses supplied synthetic ID Dirt-Synthetic-42, not an actual phone/SDK connection.
Software rendering is not TV performance.
